steps.zh: 添加 ponytail 的插件市场

steps.en: Install the plugin — as a second, separate prompt
steps.zh: 再单独发一条 prompt 安装插件

steps.en: Hooks inject the ruleset at session start and into every spawned subagent
steps.zh: hook 在会话启动时注入规则，子 agent 也同样注入

steps.en: Ask for the feature exactly as you always would
steps.zh: 照常提需求，不用改说法
steps.code: Add a cache for these API responses.

steps.en: Before writing code it stops at the first rung that holds: exist? reuse? stdlib? native? one line?
steps.zh: 动手前先停在该停的那级：该不该存在、有没有现成、标准库、原生特性、一行

steps.en: Hands back the minimal diff: deliberate corner-cuts marked, one runnable check left behind
steps.zh: 只交回最小 diff：刻意简写留了上限标记，另附一个能跑的自检
steps.code: # ponytail: global lock, per-account locks if throughput matters

value.en: You stop reviewing 400-line diffs for code the task never asked for — ~54% less code on the author's agentic benchmark, safety guards kept
value.zh: 你不用再审那些任务根本没要的包装代码——作者基准里约少 54%，护栏不砍
